en.short: This is information, not a lawyer. For a real case, speak to a lawyer or Legal Aid.
en.when_to_see_lawyer: See a lawyer or Legal Aid Council of Nigeria if you are in custody, charged with an offence, or unsure what to sign.

yo.short: Èyí jẹ́ àlàyé, kì í ṣe agbẹjọ́rò. Fún ẹjọ́ gidi, sọ̀rọ̀ pẹ̀lú agbẹjọ́rò tàbí Legal Aid.
yo.when_to_see_lawyer: Lọ sọ́dọ̀ agbẹjọ́rò tàbí Legal Aid Council of Nigeria tí wọ́n bá ti fi ọ́ sẹ́wọ̀n, tí wọ́n fi ẹ̀sùn kàn ọ́, tàbí tí o ò dá ọ lójú ohun tí o fẹ́ fọwọ́ sí.

ha.short: Wannan bayani ne, ba lauya ba. Idan kana da shari'a ta gaske, tuntuɓi lauya ko Legal Aid.
ha.when_to_see_lawyer: Je wurin lauya ko Legal Aid Council of Nigeria idan kana tsare, an tuhume ka, ko ba ka da tabbacin abin da za ka sanya hannu.
